text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho fast approaching, 
Katsuragi Ace received a certain piece of 
news—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Fréjus had to drop out of the Kikuka Sho 
due to an injury...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having run strong in both the Satsuki Sho 
and the Japanese Derby, Shiina Frejus is 
unquestionably one of the top contenders—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her raw talent, she was considered 
the strongest contender after Mr. C.B. 
heading into the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Katsuragi Ace had also told me that 
she was one of her most important rivals—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Frejus was an Umamusume who was super 
fired up to beat CB ever since the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"So, how should I put it... I felt kind of 
a kindred spirit in her. She was really 
fired up during the last summer training 
camp, too—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I bet she's still terribly frustrated 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best, for her sake too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Shiina Frejus announced 
her departure from the front lines—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? The person who just came out of 
the dorm is...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Frejus! ...Right. She's temporarily 
leaving the dorm for treatment starting 
today—)

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: “......Oh. ...Good day, Ace-san.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Tough luck about the injury. Not being 
able to compete against you in the Kikuka 
Sho... Well... it's really disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored that you feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
When you come back, we've gotta race again 
for sure. With me... and of course, with 
C.B. too. I know C.B. would love it—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Frejus?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
“......I am sorry, Ace-san. I cannot... 
grant that request.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh— What does that mean...—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Could you spare me a moment of your 
time? I wanted to tell you... and only 
you.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to the point— I do not 
plan on returning to racing for a long 
time.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
No... It might be more accurate to say 'I 
cannot return.' At least, not as I am now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Is the injury really that severe...!?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...It is true that she suffered a major 
injury. However, it is treatable, and we 
already have a clear path toward 
recovery."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
What is truly in critical condition... is 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
My spirit broke. ...Unable to endure the 
battle against C.B.-san.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yet back at summer training camp, she was 
never like that...!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
It is mere bravado. Toward those around 
me, and toward myself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I can't believe it...! After all, you 
were burning with such desire to defeat 
C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Up until I ran the Satsuki Sho, that 
was true.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
In that race, I truly realized the 
bottomless depths of CB-san's potential 
for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Possessing terrifying talent already, her 
preposterous drive to grow at an even more 
overwhelming rate was spine-chilling.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I tried to face the Nippon 
Derby believing that through hard 
training, I could surpass C.B.-san."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
To ensure that the techniques and ideals 
handed down through generations do not go 
to waste—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
To live up to the expectations the world 
has placed upon me—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume belonging to the 
prestigious Shiina family, I must carry 
myself proudly and triumphantly.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, no matter how powerful he 
may be, I must overcome Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Desperately... Desperately, desperately, 
just desperately telling myself—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—However, what the Japan Derby forced me 
to face was the same absolute gulf in 
strength between CB-san and myself.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
In that race, I was forced to realize... 
that she belongs to a completely different 
world than me...――

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Facing the gap between me and CB-san 
heading into the upcoming Kikuka Sho, I 
just didn't know what to do—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—Amidst all that, I was injured in the 
previous race.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
When the doctor told me running in the 
Kikuka Sho was hopeless, I felt a deep 
sense of frustration. Yet, at the very 
same time—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I came to realize that a part of me felt 
relieved.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: "Ah, with this, I will no longer...—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"‘That way, we won't have to face the 
overwhelming "gap" in talent between us 
and Mr. C.B.’"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't want to know. About such 
dazzling talent, and how terrified I would 
be before it.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"I no longer know... how I should run... 
in the Twinkle Series where Mr. C.B. is—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
This is... the reason why I refused a 
rematch with you. All of it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(..........................I never, ever 
expected this.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Fréjus is...— Even someone I thought was 
on the 'haves' side—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(To think there'd come a time when I'd 
think of it as a "different world.")

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I came to Tracen Academy all on my own, 
from the countryside where there were 
barely any facilities or clubs.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Unlike those blessed with talent and 
circumstance, all I could do was scramble 
to the top without resting... I was 
desperate the whole time.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(And before I knew it, as time went on, I 
had convinced myself—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(To those blessed with talent and 
environment, who others see as living in a 
"different world"—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I guess there's nothing that makes you 
feel the "gap" quite like I do—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, it wasn't like that... Even for 
those whom others see as being from 
'another world,' their own 'another world' 
existed too—)

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Please do your best in the 'Kikuka 
Sho' for my sake as well. Unlike weak me, 
whose spirit broke and can no longer 
fight—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Satsuki Sho' and the 'Japanese 
Derby.' If it's you, who challenged Mr. 
C.B. fearlessly in both—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that this might cast doubt upon 
the "common sense" that Mr. C.B. stands at 
the center of this era.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Fréjus...――

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"I shall support you from the shadows. 
...Now then, with this—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: …………I believe in you!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You can still fight! You can still run!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Because you've been fighting all this 
time! Bearing your own heritage! With 
everything you have!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's no way someone like you is weak!! 
At least to me, I've never once thought of 
you as someone weak-willed!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I know you can fight too, I just know 
it!!! Shouldering everything you carry, 
you can face forward and run again!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yes, believe it! I won't look back, I'll 
keep going!! I'll challenge C.B. at the 
Kikuka Sho, too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's why— you have to come back!! Shiina 
Frejus!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And you too!! Cast a stone with your own 
hands!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Kikuka Sho'. I'm gonna face it 
without any fear...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown. Its final race, 
the Kikuka Sho, was now right upon us—
